name: Search query
what: A search bar under a round picture: the query types in word by word, each word going from blurred to sharp as it rises a little; a loading ring fades in under the bar and turns, then rises to touch it.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f18 a still hold; from f19 one word every 4 f, each 10 f from blurred, faint and 10 px low to sharp (expo out); f42 the ring fades in (8 f) and turns once every 24 f; from f58 it rises 15 f until it touches the bar (accelerating)

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the picture and the empty bar, still

tracks.name: words
tracks.what: one word every 4 f, each blurred -> sharp, rising 10 px

tracks.name: ring in
tracks.what: the loading ring fades and grows in
